topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I found this filthy, threadbare excuse for a childhood relic at a yard sale. Here I am, rooting through some stranger’s cast-offs, and what do I stumble upon? My teddy bear, the one I thought I’d outgrown and tossed away ages ago. Now it just sits here, eyes sunken, fur matted, a stark reminder of better days. I don’t even want it back, but there it is, demanding attention, demanding I pick it up and cradle it like it still matters. People ought to know better than to sell their memories, to peddle them off to any stranger willing to take them. But here we are, and now I’m stuck with this weight in my hands, a weight that doesn’t belong to me anymore.
